data.description: A tranquil community that consists of villa clusters with courtyards.

data.answer:
Hacienda is part of the villa development in Dubailand. It is designed to offer a peaceful, secure, and family-friendly lifestyle. The community is gated and features spacious villas with modern amenities. Living in Hacienda means enjoying access to well-maintained parks, playgrounds, and scenic walking trails, perfect for families and individuals seeking privacy and tranquility.

The community is divided into clusters, with shared courtyards, enhancing the neighborhood’s charm. Six main clusters are:

  • Ponderosa: Known for spacious villas with a Mediterranean theme.
  • The Aldea: A family-friendly cluster with plenty of parks and open spaces.
  • The Centro: The central area has easy access to amenities.
  • Cordoba: Offers elegant and upscale villas with a traditional Spanish design.
  • Mallorca: Features larger, luxurious villas with expansive layouts.
  • Valencia: A peaceful residential cluster is known for its serene atmosphere.

Residents benefit from various Hacienda amenities, including communal pools, fitness centers, and paved walkways for jogging and cycling.

The Hacienda lifestyle offers a unique living experience, boasting beautifully landscaped boulevards with date trees. While Hacienda property prices remain competitive, the investment potential in this serene community is high, attracting buyers and investors to its exclusive villas and attractive real estate options.

The Hacienda real estate market offers a variety of luxurious villas, primarily designed in Spanish and Mediterranean styles. Hacienda villas are spacious, with layouts ranging from 3,800 sq. ft. to 10,000 sq. ft., and plots between 8,000 and 12,000 sq. ft. 

Hacienda property prices vary depending on the size and type of villa.

Typically, 4-bedroom villas prices start from AED 2.5M. On the other hand, 5- and 6-bedroom prices start at AED 5.4M and 8M, respectively. The charm of Hacienda Dubai lies in its mix of warm, vibrant exteriors with terracotta-tiled roofs. 

Renting a Property in Hacienda, The Villa

Those interested in renting a villa in Dubai must consider properties in Hacienda, The Villa Dubai, offering a range of luxurious villas at competitive rental rates.

Annual rent for a 4-bedroom villa starts from AED 295,000, while a 5-bedroom villa can be rented from AED 275,000. The serene surroundings, spacious living areas, and private outdoor spaces make living in Hacienda an attractive option for families and professionals.

Buying a Property in Hacienda, The Villa

Looking for villas to buy in Dubai? Buying a property in Hacienda, The Villa, offers an excellent opportunity to invest in a prestigious community. Hacienda property prices for 4-bedroom villas range between AED 2.7M. Larger 5-bedroom villas are priced at AED 6M, while 6-bedroom homes start at AED 7.6 M.

These villas offer a combination of luxury, space, and privacy, making them highly desirable for families. With rising property values and attractive rental yields, Hacienda real estate provides solid investment opportunities for homeowners and investors looking for long-term growth.

data.content:
Hacienda is a beautifully landscaped sub-community within The Villa, a prestigious residential development by Dubai Properties. The district has The Aldea to the west and The Centro to the east.

Hacienda offers a mix of 3 to 6-bedroom villas for rent or sale. These villas provide a luxurious living experience with private swimming pools, gardens, and stunning views of landscaped courtyards. The community is adorned with fountains, date trees, and parks, creating a serene environment. 


Residents enjoy access to top schools and health facilities, with the added benefit of being near the Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club. Its proximity to Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street (D54) ensures excellent connectivity to the rest of Dubai.
